name: primitives-radix-progress
title: Radix Progress
description: A dark upload card listing three files, each with a percentage, its size and a thin progress bar that fills from left to right as the number climbs.
use: Several uploads or jobs run at once and each needs its own progress readout.
avoid: It has no error or cancel state, so a stalled upload cannot be acted on from the row.
a11y: Values are exposed as a progressbar, but the bars are not named with their filenames and no reduced-motion check is made. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card headed Uploading with a grey subtitle and three stacked rows. Each row has a filename on the left, a grey percentage and size on the right, and a slim rounded track with a white fill beneath.
behaves: Each bar's white fill slides right as its value rises and springs to the new width, while the percentage beside it counts up in step. Two bars loop back to zero after finishing.
customise: Pass a numeric value with your own track and indicator elements and classes; the spring transition is a prop while colours and heights come from your styles.
weight: light: Three bars animating one transform each; nothing heavy.
